result.instructions: Tools for Freshdesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many tickets are still open and unassigned right now?"; "Show me urgent tickets that have not been resolved yet."; "What replies and notes are on the latest ticket from Jane Smith?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Freshdesk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freshdesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freshdesk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freshdesk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. freshdesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Filter tickets with the Freshdesk query language. Only these fields work: agent_id, group_id, priority, status, tag, type, due_by, fr_due_by, created_at, updated_at, closed_at, and custom fields by name. There is no subject or text search; for a requester or company use freshdesk_list_tickets (requester_id, email, company_id). The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `status:2 AND priority:3`, `created_at:>'2026-01-01'`, `agent_id:123`, `tag:'urgent'`. Up to 30 results per page, pages 1-10. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/tickets.

query.description: Freshdesk search query, e.g. "priority:3 AND status:2" (do NOT add surrounding quotes yourself — they are added for you).

page.description: Page number (1-10; search endpoints return 30 results per page and ignore per_page).

The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `email:'ada@example.com'`, `company_id:123`, `active:true`. Up to 30 results per page, pages 1-10. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/contacts.

query.description: Freshdesk search query, e.g. "company_id:123" (do NOT add surrounding quotes yourself — they are added for you).

tools.name: freshdesk_create_ticket

Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets.

cc_emails.description: Emails to CC on the ticket.

group_id.description: Id of the group to assign the ticket to.

responder_id.description: Id of the agent the ticket is assigned to.

company_id.description: Id of the company the ticket belongs to.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field name.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: Update fields on an existing ticket. Only provided fields are changed. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.

group_id.description: Id of the group to assign the ticket to.

responder_id.description: Id of the agent the ticket is assigned to.

company_id.description: Id of the company the ticket belongs to.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field name.

id.description: The ticket id to reply to.

cc_emails.description: Emails to CC on the reply.

bcc_emails.description: Emails to BCC on the reply.

id.description: The ticket id to add a note to.

private.description: Whether the note is internal/private (default true). Set false for a public note.

notify_emails.description: Agent emails to notify about this note.

tools.name: freshdesk_bulk_update_tickets
tools.title: Update many tickets
tools.description: Set the same properties on up to 100 tickets in one request (status, priority, type, group, agent, source, product), and optionally add the same public reply to each. Freshdesk runs it as a background job: the reply has a job_id; check it with freshdesk_get_job. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/bulk_update.

skip_close_notification.description: Do not email the requester when the ticket closes.

reply_body.description: Optional public reply (HTML) to add to every ticket.

from_email.description: Support email the reply is sent from.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_job
tools.title: Get background job status
tools.description: Status and progress of a Freshdesk background job, e.g. a bulk ticket update (for example "IN PROGRESS" until it ends). Freshdesk REST: GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_forward_ticket
tools.title: Forward ticket by email
tools.description: Forward a ticket to external email addresses (sends an email). Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/forward.

body.description: Message added on top of the forward, HTML.

from_email.description: Support address to send from. Default: the global support email.

tools.name: freshdesk_merge_tickets
tools.title: Merge tickets
tools.description: Merge duplicate tickets into one primary ticket. The secondary tickets get closed and their conversations move to the primary ticket. This cannot be undone. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/merge.

secondary_ids.description: Tickets to merge into the primary ticket ids.

note_in_primary.description: Note added to the primary ticket. Default: a Freshdesk note.

note_in_secondary.description: Note added to each secondary ticket. Default: a Freshdesk note.

convert_recepients_to_cc.description: Add the recipients of the secondary tickets as CC on the primary ticket (later emails on it go to them too).

tools.name: freshdesk_delete_ticket
tools.title: Delete ticket (to trash)
tools.description: Move a ticket to the trash. freshdesk_restore_ticket brings it back (list trashed tickets with freshdesk_list_tickets filter=deleted). Freshdesk REST: DELETE /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_restore_ticket
tools.title: Restore deleted ticket
tools.description: Restore a ticket from the trash. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}/restore.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_outbound_email
tools.title: Send outbound email (new ticket)
tools.description: Start a new conversation by email: creates an outbound ticket and emails the contact (a new contact is created for an unknown address). By default the ticket is Closed and assigned to you; subject and description cannot be edited later. email_config_id comes from freshdesk_list_email_configs. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/outbound_email.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field name.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_ticket_fields

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Freshdesk
prompts.description: What you can do with Freshdesk here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_urgent_or_unassigned_tickets
prompts.title: Find open, urgent or unassigned tickets
prompts.description: The AI searches tickets with the query DSL, for example by status, priority, agent, group or tag. You get a list of what needs attention.

prompts.name: read_a_ticket_with_its_replies_and_notes
prompts.title: Read a ticket with its replies and notes
prompts.description: The AI reads a ticket and its conversations, public replies and notes. It sums up what happened so far.

prompts.name: create_a_ticket_for_a_customer
prompts.title: Create a ticket for a customer
prompts.description: The AI creates a ticket with subject, description and a requester (email, requester id or phone). It can set status, priority and source.

prompts.name: reply_to_a_ticket_or_add_an_internal_note
prompts.title: Reply to a ticket or add an internal note
prompts.description: The AI adds a public reply that is sent to the requester, or a note that is private by default.

prompts.name: change_the_status_or_priority_of_tickets
prompts.title: Change the status or priority of tickets
prompts.description: The AI finds tickets and updates fields such as status or priority. Only the fields you name are changed.

prompts.name: look_up_or_add_a_contact_or_company
prompts.title: Look up or add a contact or company
prompts.description: The AI searches contacts by name, email or company, and lists companies. It can create a contact or a company.

prompts.name: update_many_tickets_at_once
prompts.title: Update many tickets at once
prompts.description: The AI finds the tickets, for example all open tickets with one tag. It sets the same status, priority, group or agent on up to 100 tickets in one step and can add the same reply to each.

prompts.name: merge_duplicate_tickets_or_forward_a_ticket
prompts.title: Merge duplicate tickets or forward a ticket
prompts.description: The AI merges tickets about the same issue into one primary ticket, or forwards a ticket by email to a colleague or a supplier.

prompts.name: answer_from_the_knowledge_base_and_canned_responses

prompts.description: The AI searches your solution articles and your canned responses, then drafts a reply that uses your approved text.

prompts.name: write_or_update_a_knowledge_base_article
prompts.title: Write or update a knowledge base article
prompts.description: The AI turns a solved ticket into a new solution article as a draft, or updates an existing article. You publish it when it is ready.

prompts.name: log_time_and_read_satisfaction_ratings
prompts.title: Log time and read satisfaction ratings
prompts.description: The AI logs time spent on a ticket and lists time entries per agent or company. It also reads the satisfaction survey results for a period.

prompts.name: manage_agents_and_groups
